notes.title: v1.0.8 Beta Now Available
notes.content:
In this update, we've fixed a good number of bugs and finally updated the French localization (a big thanks to everyone who helped with this!). 

To get the beta, right-click on Blockwick 2 in your library. Select Properties, go to the Betas tab, then choose Beta from the pulldown. Wait for it to download, and you should be all set. 

If you have any issues or feedback, please let us know.

notes.title: A Wagonload More Puzzles - Available Now
notes.content:
The enormous puzzle update is here! We’ve added all 144 puzzles from Blockwick 2 Basics. These are easier puzzles that are great for a more casual experience (also more accessible for kids).  All the puzzles still have glyphs so if you’re the more adventurous type you should still find some challenge in illumination. This update is our way of saying thank you to everyone who has supported us in our quest to create a premium puzzle game experience.

On top of the gargantuan puzzle drop, we are including a French and Spanish translation of the game. A big thanks to Ross, Vicente, Ehrlichmann, and Jonathan for the magnanimous, linguistic assistance. If you’d like us to continue adding puzzles to Blockwick 2 please don’t hesitate to tell your friends. If we reach 100,000 downloads, we’ll definitely add even more (and maybe even a puzzle editor). Tell your friends!

notes.title: Huge Puzzle Drop & More Coming Soon
notes.content:
We are on the cusp of a significant update to Blockwick 2. The biggest part of the update will be all 144 puzzles from Blockwick 2 Basics. These puzzles are easier puzzles that are great for a more casual, less brain intensive experience. 

Due to popular demand we are also adding Steam Cloud support. You'll be able to keep your game progress across multiple computers.

And finally we're also adding French and Spanish translations. Voila!

- Kieffer Bros.

notes.title: Blockwick 2 - Launching on Steam This Thursday
notes.content: We are so excited to be bringing Blockwick 2 to Steam. It's our take the sliding block puzzle, and it's coming this Thursday the 25th. 160 puzzles. A lush ambient-ish soundtrack. And built for Windows, Linux, and Mac.
